title: Enchanted Garden Light Painter
description: The user controls a floating lantern that casts dynamic colored light onto a circular arrangement of avocados. By clicking avocados to select them, adjusting the lantern's light color via an HSL hue slider, tuning the light intensity and range with additional controls, and then pressing a 'Paint' button, the selected avocados are permanently tinted with the lantern's current light color. The goal is to paint all avocados in a specific rainbow sequence validated at the end.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with three and three/addons from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load Avocado.glb and Lantern.glb using GLTFLoader. Scene setup: dark background (0x0a0a1a), a ground plane with MeshStandardMaterial, subtle ambient light (intensity 0.15), and a dim directional light. Place 6 avocado instances evenly in a circle of radius 2.5 on the ground, each scaled to roughly 15x normal size so they are clearly visible. Number them 1-6 with HTML overlay labels. Place the lantern model floating above the center, scaled appropriately, slowly bobbing up and down with a sine animation. Attach a PointLight to the lantern position with initial color white, intensity 2, distance 8. Add an HTML control panel with: (1) an HSL hue slider (0-360) that updates the lantern PointLight color in real time, (2) a light intensity slider (0.5-5.0), (3) a light range/distance slider (3-15), (4) a 'Paint Selected' button, and (5) a 'Validate Sequence' button. Interaction: clicking an avocado via raycasting toggles its selection state, shown by a visible outline or emissive highlight. Clicking 'Paint Selected' applies the current lantern color as emissive tint to all selected avocados' materials (clone materials to avoid shared state), then deselects them. The target sequence for avocados 1-6 is: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet. When 'Validate Sequence' is clicked, compare each avocado's painted hue against the target hue (within ±25 degrees tolerance). Display a result overlay showing pass/fail per avocado and an overall success message if all match. Use OrbitControls for camera navigation, initial camera at (0, 4, 7) looking at origin. Ensure all parameter changes (hue, intensity, range) visually update the lantern light in real time so the user can preview the color cast on the scene before painting.
